protocol.title: Keirin Chat continuity / capacity-proof operating protocol v1

current_research_objective: Reach scientific validation 100% primarily through historical virtual-world simulation. The fixed 100-race multi-venue batch materially revised the scientific picture: Frozen B1a is not uniformly strong and shows large venue/circumference heterogeneity. Next priority is independent different-date replication without retune, followed by scale-up toward the existing 2000-race substrate. Realtime/future dependence remains deferred to final confirmation only.

active_datasets_and_artifacts.finding: Earlier small-sample uniformly strong B1a impression does not generalize. Venue and exact-circumference heterogeneity is large; no subgroup retune from this batch.
Historical source pages can expose outcomes; KR-015 keeps virtual-world evidence retrospective unless true pre-outcome snapshots exist.

active_datasets_and_artifacts.next: Retained for final-stage genuine prospective confirmation; not throughput-critical under KR-016.

immutable_rule_summary: Historical virtual-world simulation is the primary path until final live confirmation (KR-016).
Offline simulation does not require live odds unless an experiment specifically tests odds.
Odds belong at live/manual purchase boundary.
Historical simulation uses PRE model fields only; target results/payouts are not predictor inputs.
Historical pages may be outcome-bearing; KR-015 prevents false prospective upgrades.
Exact circumference is preserved; no nearest-length coercion.
No guessed PRE fields, post-result cherry-picking, or confirmatory retune.
Venue/circumference subgroup findings from the 100R batch require independent replication before adoption.
GitHub is canonical continuity state; chat is ephemeral.

exact_next_executable_actions: Construct a fixed independent historical universe from different dates than 2026-08-11/12 and repeat Frozen B1a without retune.
Preregister exact-circumference and venue subgroup comparisons before scoring the independent batch; test whether strong/weak venue differences replicate rather than tuning to this 100R result.

After independent replication, expand historical virtual-world coverage toward the existing 2000-race substrate and characterize class/grade, finals-vs-qualifiers, solo-rider and line-structure effects.

Only after ranking/probability stability is characterized, use historical odds/settlement data to optimize ticket count, minimum required odds and bankroll allocation; realtime remains final confirmation only.
